description_en: Creates a custom image for a cloud phone
description_zh: 创建一份云手机自定义镜像
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone create-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id cp-xxxxxxxx --image-name myCustomImage --description testDescription --client-token 473469C7-AA6F-4DC5-B3DB-A3DC0DE3C83E --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateImage

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cloud phone instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the cloud phone
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the image. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the image. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 镜像的描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

ImageId.description_en: The ID of the custom image
